welcome.heading: Create Tournament
welcome.chooseMethod: Choose how you'd like to create your tournament
welcome.createNewDescription: Start from scratch and configure all tournament settings manually

single_elimination.label: Single Elimination
single_elimination.description: One loss and you're out. Classic bracket format used in professional tournaments.

double_elimination.label: Double Elimination
double_elimination.description: Two losses to be eliminated. Teams get a second chance in the lower bracket.

round_robin.label: Round Robin
round_robin.description: Everyone plays everyone. Perfect for league-style competitions.

swiss.label: Swiss System
swiss.description: Similar records face each other. Balanced matchups throughout the tournament.

shuffle.label: Shuffle Tournament
shuffle.description: Players are dynamically shuffled into balanced teams each round. Individual player competition with ELO-based team balancing.

summary.info: Review your tournament settings and click "{{button}}" when you're ready.
summary.estimatedVolumeText: Approximately {{matches}} over {{rounds}} (best of {{mapsPerMatch}}, up to {{maps}} total).

outdatedServers.title: Servers need update
outdatedServers.body: One or more enabled servers are out of date (or could not be verified) according to Steam. Update them, or disable them to continue with the remaining fleet.

alert.liveBody: Matches are currently running on servers. You cannot edit tournament settings while live (except the tournament name).
alert.pendingBody: Matches will start as soon as servers are allocated and vetoes are done. You cannot edit tournament settings while the tournament is running (except the tournament name).
alert.completedBody: This tournament has finished all matches. Create a new tournament or reset this one to start over.

live.viewBracketTooltip: View the tournament bracket and match details
live.leaderboardTooltip: Open the public leaderboard page to share with players
live.restartTooltip: End all active matches on servers and reload them (useful for stuck matches)
live.resetTooltip: End all matches and reset tournament to setup mode (keeps tournament settings but clears all match data)

reviewCard.needPlayersWarning: Need at least {{minPlayers}} players to start the tournament ({{teamSize}}v{{teamSize}} matches). Currently registered: {{registered}}
reviewCard.regenerateTooltip: Delete all current matches and regenerate the bracket with the same settings.
reviewCard.regenerateDisabledTooltip: Generate the bracket at least once (Save & Generate Brackets) before you can regenerate.

items.endMatches: End all active matches on servers
items.deleteData: Delete all match data and statistics

delete.title: 🗑️ Delete Tournament
delete.question: Are you sure you want to permanently DELETE "{{name}}"?
delete.note: 💡 Note: If you just want to start over with the same tournament settings, use "Reset to Setup" instead.

regenerate.title: 🔄 Regenerate Brackets
regenerate.liveBody: Regenerating brackets will DELETE ALL existing match data, including scores, statistics, and event history.
regenerate.areYouSure: Are you absolutely sure you want to proceed?
regenerate.setupBody: This will delete all existing matches and regenerate the bracket with the same settings.

reset.title: 🔄 Reset to Setup
reset.question: Reset "{{name}}" back to SETUP mode?

items.allowEdit: Allow you to edit settings again

reset.saveAgain: After resetting, you'll need to save again to regenerate brackets.
reset.note: 💡 Note: To completely remove the tournament, use "Delete" instead.

start.noServersBody: The tournament will start, but matches will be postponed until a server becomes available. The system will automatically allocate matches when servers are ready.
start.insufficientHeading: Not enough servers to run all first-round matches concurrently
start.insufficientBody: You currently have {{available}}, but the first round expects {{required}}. Some matches will queue and start later as servers free up.
start.uncertainBody: The tournament may start with limited or no servers available. Matches will be postponed until servers become available, and will be allocated automatically when they are ready.
start.question: Do you want to start the tournament anyway?

formActions.saveTemplateTooltip: Save current tournament configuration as a template

wizard.shuffleInfo: Shuffle tournaments don't use fixed teams. Players will be automatically balanced into teams for each match based on their Skill Ratings.
wizard.shuffleRounds: This shuffle tournament will have approximately {{rounds}} (one per selected map).
wizard.volumeAlert: With {{teams}} in a {{type}} {{format}} tournament, this bracket will have approximately {{matches}} across {{rounds}} (up to {{maps}} total).
wizard.maxRoundsHelper: Each map plays up to {{maxRounds}} rounds; winner is first to {{winRounds}} rounds.
wizard.maxRoundsHelperEmpty: Maximum number of rounds per map (default: 24, max: 30).
wizard.playerRegistrationInfo_one: Players will be registered after tournament creation. Each map selected represents one round of matches ({{count}} round total).
wizard.playerRegistrationInfo_other: Players will be registered after tournament creation. Each map selected represents one round of matches ({{count}} rounds total).
wizard.serversSummaryQueued: {{servers}} configured; the first round has {{matches}}. Matches beyond your server count wait in the queue until a server is free.

overtime.modeHelper: Standard overtime plays extra segments until a team finishes ahead. "Draws allowed" ends a tied map as a draw, while "no draws" decides it by total team damage.
overtime.tooltip: Control overtime behaviour and how ties at max rounds are handled. These settings are passed through to MatchZy as overtimeMode/overtimeSegments and share the same semantics as shuffle tournaments and manual matches.
overtime.shuffleTooltip: Control overtime behavior for shuffle matches and how ties are decided at max rounds. When overtime is disabled, tied matches can either remain draws or be decided by total team damage, depending on which option you choose.
overtime.segmentsHelper: Optional: limit the number of overtime segments. Leave empty for MatchZy default.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_one: Limit overtime to {{count}} segment. Ties after overtime are decided by total team damage.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_other: Limit overtime to {{count}} segments. Ties after overtime are decided by total team damage.

grandFinal.label: Grand Final

options.simple: Simple – single Grand Final between winners and losers bracket champions
options.none: None – winners bracket final decides the tournament (no Grand Final)
options.double: Double – bracket‑reset style (currently behaves like Simple; full reset support is planned)

grandFinal.helper: Controls how the champions of the winners and losers brackets meet at the end of the tournament.

mapPool.shuffleBody: All selected maps will be played in sequence. Each map represents one round of matches. The number of maps you choose determines the number of rounds that will be played.
mapPool.shuffleSelected: You have selected {{maps}}, so {{rounds}} will be played.

formatStep.shuffleInfo: Shuffle tournaments use Best of 1 format. Each match is a single map.

shuffleConfig.subtitle: Match Rules & Settings
shuffleConfig.teamSizeTooltip: Number of players per team. Common options: 4v4, 5v5, 6v6. Minimum 2 players, maximum 10 players per team.
shuffleConfig.teamSizeHelper: Number of players per team (default: 5 for 5v5, range: 2-10)
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsTooltip: Maximum number of rounds per match. This value is passed directly to MatchZy as mp_maxrounds. Example: 6 = MR6, 24 = MR24.
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelper: Match plays up to {{maxRounds}} rounds; winner is first to {{winRounds}} rounds
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelperEmpty: Maximum number of rounds per match (default: 24, max: 30)
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateTooltip: Choose how ELO is calculated for this tournament. By default, the 'Pure Win/Loss' template only uses match result (win/loss); stats are tracked but do not change ELO. Other templates are optional and add stat-based adjustments on top of the OpenSkill win/loss change if you want Excel-style behavior.
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateHelper: Pure Win/Loss (default): only match result affects ELO. Player stats are still recorded for leaderboards and exports, but they do not change the rating unless you select a custom template.

teamValidation.maxTeams: {{type}} allows at most {{max}} teams. You selected {{selected}}.
